title: DAG evolution atomicity, generation immutability, and crash recovery acceptance

summary.result: Candidate satisfies the acceptance contract at the public service/API/repository/UI test surfaces exercised. T1315 to T1314 evolution is accepted only as one new active child generation, and the illegal in-flight rewrite is rejected with active generation, generation ledger, node ownership, dispatch records, and task count unchanged.

method.product_code_modification: No product code was modified in the final candidate tree. A temporary acceptance-only Go test was added under internal/projectmanager/service, run, then deleted before evidence commit.

legal_case.input: Existing in-flight T1314 is preserved; diff creates T1315 and edge {from:T1315,to:T1314,kind:seq}.
legal_case.observed: T1322_EVIDENCE legal verdict=pass plan=plan-788eca1f g0=generation-06cdd3a5 g1=generation-8daa118a version_before=5 version_after=6 t1314_owner=generation-06cdd3a5 t1315_owner=generation-8daa118a dispatch_records_before=1 dispatch_records_after=1
legal_case.acceptance: One new active child generation is created; T1314 remains owned by G0 and present in active snapshot; T1315 is owned by G1; dispatch records remain stable because T1315 is blocked behind in-flight T1314.

illegal_case.input: Existing in-flight T1314 would have its dependency set rewritten through edge {from:T1314,to:T1315,kind:seq}.
illegal_case.observed: T1322_EVIDENCE reject verdict=pass plan=plan-acdfd22e active_generation=generation-8fa3bf59 version=5 generations=1 nodes=1 dispatch_records=1 tasks=1
illegal_case.acceptance: Request is rejected with ErrPlanNodeInFlight and zero active generation, generation ledger, node ownership, dispatch record, or task count changes.
